title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 6: "Hear, Israel", loving Yahweh with all your heart and teaching his words to your children.

questions.text: How is the land described in Deuteronomy 6:3?
questions.explanation: Yahweh promised that they would increase mightily in a land flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: A land of cedar and gold
A land of rivers and palm trees
A land of salt and sand
A land flowing with milk and honey

questions.text: Complete Deuteronomy 6:4: "Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is ..."
questions.explanation: The verse reads: "Hear, Israel: Yahweh is our God. Yahweh is one."

questions.text: Complete Deuteronomy 6:5: "You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your ..."
questions.explanation: They are to love Yahweh their God with all their heart, with all their soul and with all their might.

questions.text: To whom were they to teach these words diligently?
questions.explanation: The words were to be on their heart, and they were to teach them diligently to their children and talk of them at home, on the way, lying down and rising up.

questions.text: Where were they to write these words?
questions.explanation: They were to write them on the door posts of their house and on their gates.

answers.text: On the stones of the altar of burnt offering
On the walls of the tent of meeting
On the sand by the banks of the Jordan
On the door posts of their house and on their gates

questions.text: Which of these does Moses say they would receive in the land without having planted them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh would give them cities they didn't build, houses they didn't fill, cisterns they didn't dig, and vineyards and olive trees they didn't plant.

questions.text: What danger does Moses warn of once they have eaten and are full?
questions.explanation: When they eat and are full, they must beware lest they forget Yahweh, who brought them out of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

answers.text: Forgetting Yahweh, who brought them out of Egypt
Becoming too lazy to work the land
Fighting among the tribes over the cities
Selling the good land to strangers

questions.text: By whose name were they to swear?
questions.explanation: They were to fear Yahweh their God, serve him and swear by his name.

questions.text: Where had Israel tempted Yahweh, according to Deuteronomy 6:16?
questions.explanation: They were not to tempt Yahweh their God, as they tempted him in Massah.

questions.text: When a son asks what the statutes mean, what is the first thing his father is to tell him?
questions.explanation: The father is to say: "We were Pharaoh's slaves in Egypt. Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand."
